title: Sichel Vintage Letterman-Style Jacket PolyGram Label Group Records
categoryName: Clothing, Shoes & Accessories:Men:Men's Clothing:Coats, Jackets & Vests
descriptionText:
This appears to be a vintage letterman-style jacket with the branding for "Polygram Label Group," a music distribution company. The label inside the jacket is from "Sichel," which produced promotional sportswear. The jacket likely served as a promotional or team jacket for employees or affiliates of Polygram, a major music company active in the 1970s through the 1990s before merging into Universal Music Group.

The blue and black design, along with the custom embroidery, suggests it was made specifically for the Polygram team
